## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≥7/11 and both Growth (Technology 1W: +3.19%) and Value (Financials 1W: +2.73%) showing net 1W strength; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare lead: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on 1W momentum led by PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY. Financials showing leadership: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy/Real Estate soft: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND, DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Growth/Momentum concentrated in software/security names.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION, DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select telecom, chip-equipment and real estate names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +20.54%), NOW (1W: +18.77%), PANW (1W: +18.76%), ADBE (1W: +13.60%), AAPL (1W: +12.17%). Note Major Divergence: multiple mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) are in RECOVERY while NVDA, QCOM and others are BELOW TREND — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but overall 1W-positive with internal rotation; notable RECOVERYs in large caps: AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY; NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: positive on 1W but dispersion across chips vs software.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — overall Financials 1W positive and supportive of RISK-ON.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive-to-cyclical strength: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare breadth is a clear contributor to market upside.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Healthcare exposure given ABOVE TREND names (MA, V, JNJ, UNH) and the broad 1W sector breadth; reduce exposure to lagging Utilities/Real Estate/Energy names (VST, DLR, XOM/CVX) and selectively reduce exposure to BELOW TREND semiconductors (QCOM, NVDA) until trend confirms. Treat RECOVERY mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) as tactical opportunities rather than core position builds given MAJOR DIVERGENCE.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +4.42%), Financials (1W: +2.73%) — monitor earnings/guidance and bank buyback/dividend headlines. BEARISH: Utilities and Energy (Utilities 1W: -1.24%, Energy 1W: -0.80%) — defensive lag may persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for any clear break above its 1M downtrend to signal sector follow-through; AAPL hold of this week’s gains to validate RECOVERY; MA/V intra-week follow-through above recent highs to confirm Financials leadership; AMAT trend support breach would warn of broader chip weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (+85): headline on bigger dividend/buyback; JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — 1M confirmation, 1W flat so watch for follow-through. (Other top bullish names flagged in feeds include NVS and PM; monitor their price action for confirmation.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-50): comment on AI reorg underperformance; META (1W: +7.37% | 1M: -2.37%) RECOVERY — negative sentiment contrasts with short-term strength → divergence to watch. AMAT (-45): noted short interest/headline pressure; AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirms short-term pullback in a longer uptrend.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Growth/Momentum tilt given narrow tech leadership but supported by Financials and Healthcare strength. PANW ABOVE TREND, MA ABOVE TREND and JNJ ABOVE TREND are showing clear relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR DIVERGENCE—many mega-caps in RECOVERY while chips and selected defensives remain BELOW TREND, so monitor sentiment and weekly follow-through.
